<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.0732. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is 182.0732 – 1.0073 ≈ 181.0659 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass with only C, H, and O atoms is C₁₃H₉O (exact monoisotopic mass 181.06534 Da, giving [M+H]⁺ = 182.07262 Da, within <3 ppm of the observed value). No other heteroatoms are required.  

Therefore the molecular formula is:</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O</final_answer>
